definition: Waterbird families represented in the local records, using the IWC family approach. This does not reproduce the paper's unpublished 136-species selection.
coordinate_policy: Keep supplied coordinates and source CRS status. Do not relocate points using NDVI, built-up cover, or model predictions.
zero_policy: Preserve original zeros; positive records only enter the occurrence candidate output. A reported zero is not automatically a surveyed absence.
season_policy: Calendar seasons: March-May spring, June-August summer, September-November autumn, December-February winter. A separate winter season-year assigns December to the following year.
supervision_policy: Do not derive protection or restoration targets from M, HQ, fused scores, or unspecified observation counts.
